```{css, echo=FALSE}
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Lora:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,400&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500&display=swap');

body { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; background: #fafaf8; color: #2c3e50; }
h1 { font-family: 'Lora', serif; }

.contact-wrap {
  max-width: 680px;
  margin: 64px auto 80px auto;
  padding: 0 16px;
}

.contact-wrap h1 {
  font-size: 2em;
  color: #1a2e22;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.contact-intro {
  font-size: 1.05em;
  color: #4a5e52;
  line-height: 1.7;
  margin-bottom: 48px;
  max-width: 520px;
}

.contact-card {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 22px 24px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #dde5db;
  border-radius: 8px;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
}

.contact-card:hover {
  border-color: #4a7c59;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(74,124,89,0.12);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
}

.contact-icon {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  font-size: 1.3em;
}

.icon-email  { background: #e8f4ee; color: #2e7d5e; }
.icon-github { background: #eef0f4; color: #24292f; }
.icon-linkedin { background: #e8f0f8; color: #0a66c2; }
.icon-twitter { background: #e8f4fc; color: #1da1f2; }

.contact-label {
  font-size: 0.75em;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #7a9a85;
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}

.contact-value {
  font-size: 1.05em;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #1a2e22;
}

.contact-arrow {
  margin-left: auto;
  color: #aac4b2;
  font-size: 1.1em;
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
}

.contact-card:hover .contact-arrow {
  transform: translateX(4px);
  color: #4a7c59;
}
```
